_comment: Single source of truth for every bundled asset's license. scripts/ac/credits.py renders CREDITS.txt + LICENSES.md from this into each track folder. Bundle ONLY genuinely CC0/PD assets.

bundled_assets.name: Street-name sign atlas
bundled_assets.source: prodrive-ac-builder (generated; system font is a build-time tool, not shipped)

bundled_assets.name: Tree billboard (PLACEHOLDER)
bundled_assets.source: placeholder — not a verified CC0 asset yet; replaced in the v0.6.0 props pass

bundled_assets.name: gravel road (procedural)
bundled_assets._note: Synthesised, not mined — keeps road_surface:gravel tracks redistributable.

bundled_assets.name: W1-6 Large Arrow sign solids + MUTCD arrow/chevron artwork
bundled_assets.source: airoso tools/make_sign_textures.py (generated; MUTCD sign designs are public domain — MUTCD Introduction para 04, 17 U.S.C. 105)

bundled_assets.name: Concrete K-rail barrier (Kevin's owned Dropbox pack) — race-layout centre chain + kerb-line strips
bundled_assets.source: Kevin's owned asset pack (Dropbox; fleet/reference/ASSET-LIBRARY.md, ledger 0005) — bound by its own 1WALL_RACE pbr row (immune to pbr.network_walls, 2026-10-11); the race kn5's 1WALL_race_* strips sweep its measured silhouette and tile its texture at 4.04 m
bundled_assets._note: Licence not yet recorded (ledger 0047 Q10). Until it is, san_diego_lake_murray_race.kn5 and models_race_*.ini ship in the FULL (local) package only and are EXCLUDED from the CC0 variant; tools/pack_release.py must drop them when it builds cc0/.

bundled_assets.name: Invisible collider texture (procedural, fully transparent 4x4 RGBA)
bundled_assets.source: airoso tools/author_race_furniture_blend.py handoff (generated with Pillow: Image.new('RGBA', (4, 4), (0, 0, 0, 0)))
bundled_assets._note: For the deferred Macau-style tall collider sheet (ledger 0047 Q11): 1WALL_racecol_* meshes, a '1WALL_RACECOL' pbr row before '1WALL' with ALPHATEST=1. Not bound by any shipped material yet.

stock_audio_note: Surface scrub/rumble (data/surfaces.ini WAV=) references the player's own stock Assetto Corsa sounds (content/sfx). No audio is bundled or redistributed.
